mapper.insert: insert into dynamic (dynamicIndex, dynamicState, dynamicContent, dynamicTime, dynamicType, userId, language_, code, html, css, para, url, appState, text) values (#{dynamicIndex}, #{dynamicState}, #{dynamicContent}, #{dynamicTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{dynamicType}, #{userId}, #{language_}, #{code}, #{html}, #{css}, #{para}, #{url}, #{appState}, #{text})
mapper.select: select * from dynamic where userId = #{userId} order by dynamicTime desc
select * from dynamic where userId = #{userId} and dynamicState = #{dynamicState} order by dynamicTime desc
select * from dynamic where userId = #{userId} and (dynamicState = #{dynamicState1} or dynamicState = #{dynamicState2}) order by dynamicTime desc
select * from dynamic where tipOffNum = #{tipOffNum} order by dynamicTime desc
select * from dynamic order by dynamicTime desc
select * from dynamic where dynamicState = #{dynamicState} order by dynamicTime desc
select * from dynamic where dynamicIndex like concat('%', #{dynamicIndex, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') order by dynamicTime desc
select * from dynamic where dynamicType = #{dynamicType} order by dynamicTime desc
select * from (SELECT * from dynamic WHERE userId = #{userId}) as t where dynamicId >= #{dynamicId} ORDER BY dynamicTime desc LIMIT #{num}

select * from (SELECT * from dynamic WHERE userId = #{userId} and dynamicIndex like concat('%', #{dynamicIndex, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')) as t where dynamicId >= #{dynamicId} ORDER BY dynamicTime desc LIMIT #{num}
select * from dynamic where dynamicId >= #{dynamicId} ORDER BY dynamicTime desc LIMIT #{num}
select * from (SELECT * from dynamic WHERE userId = #{userId} and dynamicState = #{dynamicState}) as t where dynamicId >= #{dynamicId} ORDER BY dynamicTime desc LIMIT #{num}

select * from (SELECT * from dynamic WHERE userId = #{userId} and dynamicState = #{dynamicState} and dynamicType = #{dynamicType}) as t where dynamicId >= #{dynamicId} ORDER BY dynamicTime desc LIMIT #{num}
select * from dynamic where userId = #{userId} and dynamicState = #{dynamicState} and dynamicType = #{dynamicType} order by dynamicTime desc
